ideas.title: The Business of Billing: Uncovering Potential Fraud in Minnesota's Medicaid Program
ideas.description: Investigate the business practices of companies billing Minnesota's Medicaid program and potential ties to fraud
questions: What are the common business practices among companies billing Medicaid?
Are there any ties to organized crime or other illicit activities?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger pattern of fraud and abuse in Minnesota's Medicaid program
